qa_pair.question: Inspect the MCP tool metadata, project source-control status, and Smart Lock policy for a project-contained path using read-only calls. Does policy inspection itself contact a Git remote? Respond True or False.

Inspect repository integration state and then try the read-only semantic-conflict inspector while no merge or rebase is active. What exact JSON value must operation report for the inspector to remain unavailable?
Read source-control status, preview integration against HEAD, and inspect semantic-conflict eligibility. When projectOwnsWorktree is true, which root must own the active merge or rebase?
Inspect the Smart Lock rule-list and policy-inspection contracts. If multiple enabled rules match the same asset, which matching position determines policy?
Inspect the rule-list, create-rule, and update-rule schemas and their bounded policy documentation without mutating state. What is the maximum number of Smart Lock rules in one project?

Compare source-control remote-ref inspection with Smart Lock policy inspection for a configured remote destination. What exact freshnessScope value identifies a locally cached remote-tracking revision?
Inspect the semantic conflict and standalone semantic merge tool contracts. Besides a scene JSON manifest, which single file extension is eligible for integrated Git-stage structural resolution?

Compare the read-only semantic conflict result contract with the apply-and-stage schema. Are both the exact stage fingerprint and exact semantic output hash required before applying? Respond True or False.
Inspect collaboration status, Smart Lock policy mutation metadata, and semantic apply metadata. Which collaboration role is required for those policy/apply mutations when enforcement is enabled?
Compare lock-list evidence, Smart Lock policy evidence, and release behavior. Which retention value blocks normal release until the acquisition branch is clean and merged?
